title: The Krptonians
description: A mod made in 3 hours that aims to add Kryptonian superpowers and supermans costume! fully obtainable in survival! (part of my 3 hour challenge series)
body:
This mod is a further continuation of my "3 hour challenge" series, designed to create a full character in JUST 3 hours! 

This mod adds in the Kryptonian side of the DC universe. Inspired by many differnt works on how to obtain powers, such as the legends mod or fisks superheros. I made it while streaming so of course- i missed some spots. 

Overall though, i would say it's a fairly decent mod. it adds in: 
 

The Kryptonian gene - gain the speed, strength, durability, flight, laser vision AND frost breath of a Kryptonian. you'll instantly be the most powerful player on any server with this mod! 

Superman new 52 suit - Clark kents "superman" costume, based on the New 52 design. (my fav) complete with a black suit varient. 

Solar suit - a new that "supercharges" your kryptonian abelites by letting you absorb sunlight faster. (does not really increase your strength)

Super boy outfit - Superboy from the young justice show, i added the outfit because i had a little bit of extra time. 

 

You can get the powers by killing a Kryptionian mob and grinding their bones in a brewing stand, to get a potion of their DNA. you can then put that into a crafting table with a quartz crystal and an iron nugget. (nugget bottom left and quartz top right)
This gives you a syringe filled with blood. right click and hold to inject yourself.

I recommend full diamond (or at least half) armor to fight any kryptionian. 

ONCE AGAIN, I DO NOT OWN THE CHARACTERS OR CONCEPTS!
